authorize.title: Sign in to Antigravity
authorize.description:
1. Open the [Google sign-in page]({auth_url}) and sign in with the account that has the Antigravity subscription.
2. Google then redirects to `{redirect_uri}`. That page does not load; this is expected.
3. Copy the whole address from the browser's address bar and paste it below.

data_description.redirect_url: The full `{redirect_uri}?...` address, or just the value of its `code` parameter.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The sign-in for {name} expired or was revoked. Sign in again to keep using Antigravity.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed. The code may have expired or been used already; open the sign-in page again and paste the new address.

abort.not_eligible: This Google account has no Antigravity subscription.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different Google account than the one configured.

quota_exhausted.message: Your Antigravity quota for this model is used up until {reset}. Pick a model from another quota group or wait.

sign_in_required.message: Antigravity needs you to sign in again (Settings → Devices & services).

model_unavailable.message: The selected model is not in your Antigravity subscription right now.

response_blocked.message: The model stopped without an answer (reason: {reason}).

invalid_json.message: The model did not return valid JSON for the requested structure.

data_description.chat_model: Models from your Antigravity subscription. Gemini models use the Gemini quota; Claude and GPT-OSS share a separate quota.
data_description.reasoning_effort: Higher effort thinks longer: slower replies and more quota. Models with a single level ignore this.
data_description.prompt: Instruct how the agent should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.web_search: Lets the agent search the web with Google. Each search is a separate request that uses Gemini quota.
